title: Sid Turcotte Park Campground And Cabin Resort

services.name: Rv & Tent Sites
services.desc: Our un-serviced sites can accommodate tents and small RV’s and have some of the best views in the campground. We have a couple sites suitable for larger RV’s too. These sites have no electricity or water at the site. Potable water is available elsewhere in the campground and most are close to the washrooms. Shady and sunny sites available. Our 15 amp and water sites offer a rustic feel, with some electricity and a water spigot right on your site. Shady and sunny sites available. Many of these sites are great for camping with friends and one area between the ponds is a great area for group camping. P97 is only15 amp and water but is near the water and has a view. services.name: Cabins & Cottages
services.desc: Full size kitchen includes a residential fridge, stove and microwave, table, chairs, dishes, pots & pans, utensils, cutlery and glassware. Also included is a toaster and coffee maker and filters (bring your own coffee grounds). Other items included are air conditioning, Internet/ smart TV, sofa, chair, reading lamp, coffee table, BBQ, gas fireplace, outside campfire pit, picnic table and parking for one vehicle. Cedar 1 fees includes 5 people. 4 Adults Maximum. No additional overnight quests are permitted.
